page_title: SEV 1-1 RMA | Sevilla v Real Madrid 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+9' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
90+8' Real Madrid will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
90+6' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+5' The free kick evades the keeper and presents Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) with an almost open goal, but he somehow heads high over the bar from close in.
90+4' Sevilla will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
90+4' The referee is firm and issues Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) a deserved yellow card.
90' Real Madrid have a corner.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Ferland Mendy cannot continue after picking up an injury.
88' Substitution. Vinicius Junior did his best and is replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
87' Diego Alonso decides to make a substitution. Youssef En Nesyri will be replaced by Rafa Mir (Sevilla).
87' Substitution. Djibril Sow leaves the pitch and is replaced by Erik Lamela (Sevilla).
87' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows a yellow card to Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) for a tough tackle.
87' The main referee, Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is given a yellow card for dissent.
86' Real Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
86' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
85' Although Carlo Ancelotti (Real Madrid) is just on the bench, Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
84' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
81' Suso (Sevilla) tries his luck from the edge of the box, but it's one to forget and goes well wide of the left post.

81' What a save from Kepa Arrizabalaga! Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
80' The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
79' Here is a change. Rodrygo is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Joselu (Real Madrid).

78' 1 - 1 Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space to meet the resulting set piece inside the box and produces a perfect header into the top of the net.
77' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nemanja Gudelj as he is replaced by Loic Bade (Sevilla).
76' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Sergio Ramos (Sevilla).
74' It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for David Alaba (Real Madrid), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:0.
72' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Kepa Arrizabalaga, who pulls off a stunning save!
71' Suso (Sevilla) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
71' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
67' Substitution. Dodi Lukebakio makes way for Suso (Sevilla).
67' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Federico Valverde and he is replaced by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
67' The substitution is prepared. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aurelien Tchouameni.
66' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
65' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
64' The attendance for today's match is 41212.
63' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.

60' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea with no other option than to blow for a foul.
60' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
57' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

57' CHANCE! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a low shot to the bottom right corner, but Orjan Nyland produces an excellent save. Real Madrid earn a corner.
55' David Alaba (Real Madrid) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.
55' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
54' Real Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
51' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
49' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul after Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
48' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

47' What a save from Kepa Arrizabalaga! Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
42' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
41' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is about to take a corner kick.
41' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.
40' A nice lofted cross finds Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) unmarked. He takes an excellent touch and gets in a shot that goes towards the middle of the net. An easy save for the goalkeeper, though.
40' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
38' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' The defender bravely blocks the shot from David Alaba (Real Madrid) inside the box.
33' Poor challenge! Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is penalised for tripping and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle. Real Madrid have a free kick from a promising distance.
31' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Kepa Arrizabalaga comes off his line to gather the ball.
29' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
28' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
25' Chance! Djibril Sow (Sevilla) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
25' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
24' Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
24' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.

21' That didn't go as planned! Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Kepa Arrizabalaga, who easily kept it out.
20' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
18' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea no option but to blow his whistle.
17' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
15' Real Madrid fail to score from a corner as Orjan Nyland (Sevilla) leaps to collect the ball.

15' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
14' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
10' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Orjan Nyland and he makes a comfortable save.
10' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
7' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
6' The goal by Real Madrid is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
6' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Real Madrid can stand using VAR.
4' Goal! Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
4' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

4' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.
3' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
2' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Sevilla will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
